changeSet.author: nexus-2x9xa
changeSet.comment: nexus.quarantine_reattach_plan: the read-only classifier behind the restore verb's reattach step. For each named chash it resolves the live owning document (forward by metadata catalog_doc_id/doc_id, else reverse by a single live note's own doc_id, the census's two paths) and the manifest position, and returns a jsonb array of {chash, verdict, why, doc, title, pos, chunk_title, ls, le, cs, ce} with verdict attach, superseded (why says which of ten reasons), no_live_owner, no_position or owned. A complete, failed or mid-run owner, a content hash that differs from the document's, another chunk of the same document at the same position (in the collection or in any quarantine collection holding chunks tagged for it), and a taken or out-of-range position all refuse. Never writes.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.quarantine_reattach_plan( p_tenant_id text, p_origin_collection text, p_quarantine_collection text, p_chashes text[], p_from_quarantine boolean ) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $plan$ WITH cand AS ( -- One row per named chash that exists in the origin or (p_from_quarantine, the dry run) in this origin's -- quarantine sibling. The origin row's metadata wins: a present chunk is judged by what the origin holds. SELECT r.h AS chash, decode(r.h, 'hex') AS chash_b, COALESCE(o.metadata, q.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS meta FROM unnest(p_chashes) AS r(h) LEFT JOIN nexus.chunks o ON o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND o.collection = p_origin_collection AND o.chash = decode(r.h, 'hex') LEFT JOIN nexus.chunks q ON p_from_quarantine AND q.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND q.collection = p_quarantine_collection AND q.chash = decode(r.h, 'hex') AND COALESCE(q.metadata->>'origin_collection', p_origin_collection) = p_origin_collection WHERE o.chash IS NOT NULL OR q.chash IS NOT NULL ), keyed AS ( SELECT c.*, NULLIF(COALESCE(NULLIF(c.meta->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(c.meta->>'doc_id', '')), '') AS fwd_key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND m.collection = p_origin_collection AND m.chash = c.chash_b) AS owned FROM cand c ), fwd AS ( -- The forward owner: a LIVE document anywhere in the tenant (the census's precedence: a live forward owner -- wins even when it is registered under another collection, in which case the chunk is not ours to attach). SELECT k.chash, d.tumbler, d.title, d.physical_collection, d.chunk_count, d.index_state, d.index_content_hash AS doc_hash FROM keyed k JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND d.tumbler = k.fwd_key AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ), rev_all AS ( SELECT k.chash, d.tumbler, d.title, d.chunk_count, d.index_state, d.index_content_hash AS doc_hash FROM keyed k JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND d.physical_collection = p_origin_collection AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(d.file_path, '') = '' AND d.metadata->>'doc_id' = k.chash WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fwd f WHERE f.chash = k.chash) ), rev AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.chash) a.chash, a.tumbler, a.title, a.chunk_count, a.index_state, a.doc_hash, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.chash) AS n FROM rev_all a ORDER BY a.chash, a.tumbler ), own AS ( SELECT f.chash, f.tumbler, f.title, f.chunk_count, f.index_state, f.doc_hash, 'forward'::text AS path, (f.physical_collection IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_origin_collection) AS in_origin, 1::bigint AS n FROM fwd f UNION ALL SELECT v.chash, v.tumbler, v.title, v.chunk_count, v.index_state, v.doc_hash, 'reverse'::text, true, v.n FROM rev v ), placed AS ( SELECT k.chash, k.chash_b, k.meta, k.owned, o.tumbler, o.title, o.chunk_count, o.index_state, o.doc_hash, o.path, o.in_origin, o.n, CASE WHEN o.tumbler IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN o.path = 'forward' AND k.meta->>'chunk_index' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (k.meta->>'chunk_index')::integer WHEN COALESCE(o.chunk_count, 0) <= 1 THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS pos FROM keyed k LEFT JOIN own o ON o.chash = k.chash ), rival_rows AS MATERIALIZED ( -- Every OTHER chunk, in the origin or in ANY quarantine collection that holds chunks tagged for this origin, -- whose forward key names one of the documents being judged, whichever path (forward or reverse) placed the -- chunk on it: the stored versions of the document, not only the chashes this call names. Two chunks that claim -- one (document, position) are two versions of it, and a call that took only one of them (a 1000-row page -- boundary, a second call, the other sibling) must still see the other. A single-chunk legacy note (reverse -- path, position 0) is judged the same way: a keyed chunk that names the note at position 0 (or, the note -- registering at most one chunk, at no position) is its rival. The origin and p_quarantine_collection are -- scanned as before (an untagged chunk there is taken for this origin's); any OTHER quarantine collection of -- the tenant counts only for a chunk whose origin_collection tag names this origin, so a chunk of another -- origin in a shared sibling is no rival. One scan of the origin and the siblings. SELECT x.chash AS x_chash, COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')) AS x_key, x.metadata->>'chunk_index' AS x_ci FROM nexus.chunks x WHERE x.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND x.collection IN (p_origin_collection, p_quarantine_collection) AND COALESCE(x.metadata->>'origin_collection', p_origin_collection) = p_origin_collection AND COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')) IN (SELECT pp.tumbler FROM placed pp WHERE pp.tumbler IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL -- The other quarantine collections, one indexed probe per collection (a join, not an OR, so the collection -- index is used); a chunk counts only when its own tag names this origin. SELECT x.chash, COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')), x.metadata->>'chunk_index' FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc JOIN nexus.chunks x ON x.tenant_id = cc.tenant_id AND x.collection = cc.name WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND cc.lifecycle_state = 'quarantine' AND cc.name <> p_quarantine_collection AND x.metadata->>'origin_collection' = p_origin_collection AND COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')) IN (SELECT pp.tumbler FROM placed pp WHERE pp.tumbler IS NOT NULL) ), judged AS ( SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.owned THEN 'owned' WHEN p.tumbler IS NULL OR p.n <> 1 OR NOT p.in_origin THEN 'no_live_owner' -- The document's own state decides before its position does: a document that is mid index run, or -- stamped complete, has a manifest that is authoritative for its text (a complete stamp is verified -- against the manifest, so a manifest-less chunk of it is stale by definition, and a document -- emptied on purpose reads chunk_count 0 and complete). Legacy documents are unstamped. WHEN p.index_state = 'indexing' THEN 'superseded:indexing' WHEN p.index_state = 'complete' THEN 'superseded:complete' -- An index run that FAILED (CatalogRepository.failIndexRun) leaves whatever manifest it had written: -- partial, and unknown to this function. Refuse rather than guess, as for a mid-run document. WHEN p.index_state = 'failed' THEN 'superseded:failed' WHEN p.pos IS NULL THEN 'no_position' -- The chunk records the content hash of the file version it was cut from; a document that has -- since been indexed from other content records a different one. WHEN NULLIF(p.meta->>'content_hash', '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(p.doc_hash, '') IS NOT NULL AND p.meta->>'content_hash' <> p.doc_hash THEN 'superseded:version' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND m.doc_id = p.tumbler AND m.position = p.pos) THEN 'superseded:position_taken' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rival_rows r WHERE r.x_key = p.tumbler AND r.x_chash <> p.chash_b AND (CASE WHEN r.x_ci ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN r.x_ci::integer WHEN COALESCE(p.chunk_count, 0) <= 1 THEN 0 END) = p.pos) THEN 'superseded:rival' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND m.doc_id = p.tumbler AND m.collection IS DISTINCT FROM p_origin_collection) THEN 'superseded:other_collection' WHEN p.path = 'reverse' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND m.doc_id = p.tumbler) THEN 'superseded:has_rows' WHEN COALESCE(p.chunk_count, 0) > 0 AND p.pos >= p.chunk_count THEN 'superseded:past_end' ELSE 'attach' END AS v FROM placed p ) SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'chash', j.chash, 'verdict', split_part(j.v, ':', 1), 'why', NULLIF(split_part(j.v, ':', 2), ''), 'doc', CASE WHEN j.n = 1 THEN j.tumbler END, 'title', CASE WHEN j.n = 1 THEN j.title END, 'pos', j.pos, 'chunk_title', NULLIF(j.meta->>'title', ''), 'ls', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'line_start' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'line_start')::integer END, 'le', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'line_end' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'line_end')::integer END, 'cs', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'chunk_start_char' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'chunk_start_char')::integer END, 'ce', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'chunk_end_char' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'chunk_end_char')::integer END ) ORDER BY j.chash), '[]'::jsonb) FROM judged j; $plan$;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION nexus.quarantine_reattach_plan(text, text, text, text[], boolean) TO nexus_svc;

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.quarantine_reattach_plan(text, text, text, text[], boolean);

changeSet.comment: nexus.quarantine_restore_chunks: the quarantine restore verb's move. DELETE ... RETURNING from the quarantine sibling into an INSERT into the origin in one statement under the exclusive sweep gate, for chashes the caller names (no manifest row needed); a chash already in the origin is skipped, never overwritten (a different embedding width is reported as dim_conflict); the restored row takes last_written_at = now() so it is not immediately reapable; with p_reattach (the default) a chunk whose metadata names a live document of the origin also gets that document's manifest row at its position, unless the document's manifest already holds another chunk there (superseded) so the chunk is visible to search and get again; one quarantine_restore gc_audit row per call that restores or attaches anything; one result row per requested chash. Dry-run form classifies only.

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.quarantine_restore_chunks(text, text, text, text[], text, bigint, boolean, boolean);
